results: The shared full original H-minus-one physical pencil is normalized by the same fixed free H1-to-H-minus-one isomorphism. Its invertibility is EXACTLY physical full-domain bijectivity. Joint operator-norm analyticity uses the already-verified hminusOneMultiplicationFamily on the ENTIRE original H-minus-one potential space;no new endpoint convergence assumption is imposed.

The full original joint resolvent locus in H-minus-one times C is open. The actual H1-valued inverse and compact H-minus-one base resolvent are jointly norm analytic at every physical resolvent pair and satisfy both full-domain inverse identities,for ALL original H-minus-one data. These total inverse families agree EXACTLY with the previously verified endpoint inverses,on and off their resolvent sets.

A whole compact spectral circle remains in the full original resolvent on an OPEN set of H-minus-one potentials. The original circular Riesz projection is operator-norm continuous along every original H-minus-one continuous family with a common valid circle,and agrees literally with the verified actual endpoint projection.

On EVERY original endpoint norm-bounded physical weak-star set,the exact original H-minus-one realization is continuous. Consequently the JOINT physical source resolvent locus is weak-star-times-C open,and the full original H1-valued inverse and compact H-minus-one resolvent are norm continuous at each valid pair. Membership of each fixed actual complex spectral value is weak-star closed within the bounded set.

Validity of the ENTIRE compact physical resolvent circle is weak-star OPEN within every original endpoint norm-bounded set. The SAME ACTUAL projection varies continuously in operator norm on that full locus. It is an actual finite-rank idempotent;its rank is locally constant and both circle validity and rank persist throughout a weak-star neighborhood. No simple-eigenvalue or noncollapsed-gap assumption is imposed.

The finite ACTUAL physical spectrum inside any disk is constructed from existing full-spectrum local finiteness,without a supplied root list. The projection range is EXACTLY the sum of all enclosed original full physical algebraic root spaces. Their independence identifies projection rank with the sum of ACTUAL algebraic multiplicities,and this entire enclosed count is weak-star locally stable on bounded physical sets.

domains.count: Finite actual enclosed sourceHillSpectrum values,each counted by the dimension of its FULL original physical algebraic root space. No simple-root,open-gap,provided-label or finite root table hypothesis.
domains.closedness: A FIXED actual spectral value has a relatively closed membership locus on bounded original sets. This alone is NOT claimed to prove equality-of-entire-spectrum closedness.
